description: Fork of exp002 with three changes: (1) unembedder simplified to LN(384) + Linear(384, 32768) (drops the hidden 1536-MLP layer); (2) out_proj tph FLAT at 2048 across all 6 layers (was graded 2048->256); (3) V tph FLAT at 512 across all layers (was graded 512->64). Bit-LUT capacity ~doubles vs exp002 (~50 MiB packed); continuous Adam params drop ~53M -> ~14.9M. Cleaner architecture for finding the LUT bottleneck.
